extracted.intended_audience: small businesses, start-ups, and SBIR/STTR applicants seeking DARPA funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for small businesses pursuing DARPA opportunities under SBIR/STTR: how to access program support, prepare proposals, navigate review/selection, and complete contracting and transition efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility to participate
rubrics_metrics.description: Our opportunities are open to all eligible performers – from start-ups to larger firms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm your eligibility before applying; DARPA emphasizes access for small business but eligibility rules apply (implied: follow SBIR/STTR eligibility criteria).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the SBIR/STTR program pathways
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure access for small business, we offer specialized support and manage topics under the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit and manage proposals under the SBIR/STTR tracks as appropriate; these are the program vehicles through which DARPA manages small-business topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek DARPAConnect proposal support and mentoring
rubrics_metrics.description: No matter where you are in your journey with us, DARPAConnect is a valuable resource. Get access to a comprehensive curriculum, proposal support, mentoring, and one-on-one coaching.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use DARPAConnect resources (curriculum, mentoring, one-on-one coaching) to prepare stronger proposals and navigate program processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with DARPA mission: radical, game-changing technologies for national security
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Small Business Programs Office (SBPO) enables the small business community to create and transition radical, game-changing technologies that benefit national security, the federal government, and the commercial marketplace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should aim to develop radical, game-changing technologies with clear relevance to national security, government needs, or commercial impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transition and commercialization focus
rubrics_metrics.description: We empower small businesses to transform research into viable products, secure funding, and contribute to economic growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate a plan for transition and commercialization (how research becomes a viable product, routes to funding, and broader economic impact); DARPA values eventual transition to government use and/or commercial markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Contract Management Office (CMO) instructions and contractual terms
rubrics_metrics.description: The Contract Management Office (CMO) team provides helpful instructions for proposers, including general terms and conditions, grants and agreements, procurement contracts, and other transactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be prepared to comply with CMO-provided procedures and contractual requirements during award administration (review general terms and conditions, understand grants/agreements/procurement contracting implications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Expect a formal review and selection process
rubrics_metrics.description: After a review process, DARPA selects the winning proposal, notifies applicants, and awards a contract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposers should be aware that submissions undergo review; selection leads to notification and contract award—plan timelines and readiness for post-selection contracting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage DARPA resources and community networks
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources: DoW Office of Small Business Programs; U.S. Small Business Administration; National Apex Accelerator Alliance (NAPEX); APEX Accelerators; RSS feed for Opportunities. Communities: Academia, Defense and Government, Entrepreneurs, Industry, Small Business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage with listed resources and communities (e.g., SBA, accelerators, community networks) to strengthen proposals, find partners, and support transition/commercialization activities.
